{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with the highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check the actual number of sites
total_patients = len(df_dedup)
actual_sites = df_dedup['site'].unique()

# Calculate response rate per site
response_rate_by_site = df_dedup.groupby('site')['responded'].mean().round(4)

# Find the site with the highest response rate
highest_response_rate_site = response_rate_by_site.idxmax()
highest_response_rate_value = response_rate_by_site.max()

# Output results
total_patients, actual_sites, response_rate_by_site, highest_response_rate_site, highest_response_rate_value"}
